name: Animal Speaker (Racial)
body:
You can speak with all animals.

Prerequisite: Hengeyokai, Wisdom 13, Clan-Animal Speaker

Benefit: You can now use the speak with animals spell-like ability, granted by the Clan-Animal Speaker feat to speak with any animal. You also gain an additional 3 uses of this ability per day.
